settings.name: Homepage URL
settings.description: The URL loaded when the browser starts or a new tab is opened

settings.name: Search Engine URL
settings.description: Search engine URL template (%s is replaced with the search query)

settings.name: URL Autocomplete Suggestions
settings.description: Show autocomplete suggestions in the address bar

settings.name: Open target="_blank" in New Tab
settings.description: Open links with target="_blank" in a new browser tab

settings.name: Middle-Click Opens New Tab
settings.description: Open links in a new tab when clicked with the middle mouse button

settings.name: Switch Immediately to New Tabs
settings.description: Switch focus immediately to newly opened tabs

settings.name: Prefer Dark Mode
settings.description: Prefer dark color scheme for web pages (prefers-color-scheme: dark)

settings.name: Default Page Zoom
settings.description: Default page zoom percentage

settings.name: Allow Page CSS Stylesheets
settings.description: Allow web pages to use their own CSS stylesheets

settings.name: Default Font Family
settings.description: Default font family used when a page does not specify one

settings.name: Default Font Size
settings.description: Default base font size for web pages

settings.name: Minimum Font Size
settings.description: Minimum font size allowed on web pages

settings.name: Treeview UI Font Size
settings.description: Font size used in Bookmarks, History, and Cookie manager trees

settings.name: Enable JavaScript
settings.description: Enable JavaScript execution on web pages

settings.name: JavaScript Timeout
settings.description: Maximum time to wait for a script to finish executing

settings.name: Load Foreground Images
settings.description: Fetch and display foreground elements on web pages

settings.description: Fetch and display CSS background images on web pages

settings.description: Play animated GIFs and multi-frame images

settings.name: Incremental Reflow
settings.description: Reflow pages incrementally while resources are loading

settings.name: Minimum Reflow Interval
settings.description: Minimum time between incremental page reflows while loading

settings.description: Hide known advertisement elements on web pages

settings.description: Send Do Not Track (DNT: 1) header with web requests

settings.description: Send the HTTP Referer header when navigating between pages

settings.name: Display Decoded International Domain Names
settings.description: Display decoded Unicode international domain names instead of Punycode

settings.name: History Retention Period
settings.description: Number of days to keep visited URLs in browsing history

settings.name: Persist Browsing Data
settings.description: Save browsing history, cookies, and bookmarks to disk

settings.name: Accept-Language Header
settings.description: Preferred languages sent in the HTTP Accept-Language header

settings.name: Accept-Charset Header
settings.description: Preferred character encoding sent in the HTTP Accept-Charset header

settings.name: Max Simultaneous Fetchers
settings.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active network fetches

settings.name: Max Fetchers Per Host
settings.description: Maximum simultaneous network connections per host

settings.name: Max Retried Fetches
settings.description: Number of times to retry timed-out fetches before giving up

settings.name: Redirect Limit
settings.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow before a fetch fails

settings.name: Memory Cache Size
settings.description: Maximum size of the in-memory resource cache

settings.name: Disk Cache Size
settings.description: Maximum size of the on-disk resource cache

settings.name: Disk Cache Expiry Age
settings.description: Maximum number of days to keep items in the disk cache

settings.description: Port number of the HTTP proxy server

settings.description: Authentication method used by the HTTP proxy server

settings.description: Password for HTTP proxy authentication

settings.name: No Proxy Hosts
settings.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that bypass the HTTP proxy
